crypto_headlines.title: Strive buys 6,182 BTC, now holds 43,000
crypto_headlines.summary: Bitcoin Magazine reports Nasdaq-listed Strive bought 6,182 Bitcoin for $511.4M, bringing its treasury to 43,000 BTC.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin ETFs back to inflows last week
crypto_headlines.summary: US spot BTC ETFs took in a net $442.67M last week and XRP ETFs $4.25M, while ETH ETFs saw $224.96M leave and SOL ETFs $17.3M.

crypto_headlines.title: Vanguard takes a stake in Metaplanet
crypto_headlines.summary: Watcher.Guru reports Vanguard bought $7.5M worth of shares in Japanese Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC and gold are 2026's weakest major assets so far
crypto_headlines.summary: Per Charlie Bilello, Bitcoin is down 7.3% and gold 7.5% for the year so far, the first time both have been the worst-performing majors in the same year.

crypto_headlines.title: Big macro week: Fed decision Wednesday
crypto_headlines.summary: The October Fed rate decision lands Wednesday, with September PCE inflation and Q3 GDP on Thursday, plus Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Intel earnings.

crypto_headlines.title: Blast's normal withdrawal page closes today
crypto_headlines.summary: As the Blast L2 shuts down, its standard withdrawal interface closes today. After that, withdrawals need direct interaction with the Ethereum bridge contracts.

doginal_news.title: Andmetax takes the Charlotte pop-out crown
doginal_news.summary: RealMj congratulated Andmetax on winning the Charlotte, North Carolina DDLTCG pop-out and thanked everyone who helped Rise of the Pack trend in NC. Next stop is the official Championship in Miami.

doginal_news.title: Players gear up for the DDMIAMI 2026 Championship
doginal_news.summary: Andmetax shared how he is preparing for the DDMIAMI 2026 Official Championship and shouted out the players he faced in person.

doginal_news.title: Make It Memorable. Make It Doginal.
doginal_news.summary: Community members spent Sunday posting their own takes on the "Make It Memorable. Make It Doginal." theme, and @doginaldogs reposted a stack of them.

doginal_news.title: Big card pull clip
doginal_news.summary: GRT shared a pack-opening video of what he calls one of the deadliest cards pulled, reposted by @doginaldogs.

doginal_news.title: "Big Pyth week ahead"
doginal_news.summary: PIRB is teasing a big week for Pyth Network, and Monday's Pyth Wheel spins have reset for the community.

doginal_news.title: Pyth and around-the-clock stock trading
doginal_news.summary: MSB Intel notes Nasdaq plans 23-hour US stock trading from December 6, and says Pyth data powered more than $2 trillion in Q3 notional volume on traditional assets on venues that already trade every hour of the week.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs or @PythNetwork in the last 24 hours (reposts and replies only), so these items come from community posts they shared or replied to.
